objects.name: Ellis
remainingDifferences: Hair locks are more regular and compact than the target’s larger asymmetrical swept groups; fine strand/cloth/skin texture is simplified. The native result now meets the coherent soft-volume and readability criteria.
Broad balanced lighting replaces the target’s privileged orange side rim, as required for rotational world sprites.
Fixed registered framing and native contact/clearance limits retain a more compact body presentation than the enlarged target. No target framing fit is applied.
Meals remain exact canonical packed2D images with the original fixed camera-ray depth. They intentionally retain their existing graphic food appearance.

objects.name: June
remainingDifferences: The front target has larger eyes, longer visible trouser/shoe proportions, more garment detailing and a looser flowing crown. This candidate keeps the registered functional rig/contact scale and uses a simpler polo plus a more radial hair sweep; the result is readable and materially improved.

The candidate is less glossy and has less dramatic rim lighting than the generated target. Its softer native finish is consistent with the chosen warm cartoon direction and avoids copying target halos.
The target supplies no unseen side/rear reference. These views are approved for coherent native construction and readability, not asserted target identity.

objects.name: World coin icon
remainingDifferences: The candidate uses a smoothly rounded turned rim rather than the target’s more angular/chamfered outer edge and sharper polished streaks; the softer treatment fits the chosen cartoon finish.
The native gold is more softly diffuse and less mirror-like than the ImageGen target. This preserves readable midtones and avoids copying its preferred-side glare.

It retains three original-role glints instead of the target’s four and does not enlarge the object to match the target’s normalized silhouette. Spark count is nonfunctional, and the compact registered scale is deliberately preserved.
Late runtime frames naturally become faint under the frozen alpha fade, and first/last native phases are nearly vanished. Those phase semantics are intentional, not missing imagery.

objects.name: Whole broken sofa
remainingDifferences: Cushions and arms are more regular and less deeply rumpled than the painted target; the target has more irregular compression, sharper cloth folds and more abundant torn/stuffed areas. The candidate still meets the frozen soft upholstered-volume and discarded-character outcomes.

The native design uses restrained low-contrast wear, cleaner piping and a narrow seat tear instead of reproducing the target stain/stitch count or its extra back/arm tears. Fine surface detail recedes more at phone size; the major worn cues remain readable.
Target framing, enlarged apparent scale, orange edge halo and incidental imagegen surface noise were not copied. Registered source projection and animation semantics take precedence.

Thin native trim/repair solids include some zero-area bevel corner faces and evaluated capped curve details report boundary loops. Main mesh solids have no nonmanifold edges, and no corresponding visible shipping artifact was found. Approval does not claim every evaluated detail is a single watertight mesh suitable for an unrelated3D export.
